Cetaphil Daily Facial Moisturizer w/spf 35 has been my only lotion for a couple years. It's lightweight but gives me the moisturizer I need, with the bonus spf for protection. Plus the pump bottle is easy to use.

avis.titre: Great for daily and on the move use.
avis.texte: The cream was very smoothing after application. Looks darker than my skin tone but it blended in very nicely and didn't look patchy or out of tone.

This is a great product for a daily sunscreen! It's not to thick and doesn't leave to bad of a white cast! Especially when using it under makeup I think it wears well! It rubs in pretty easily as well! I use it daily!!
Great daily moisturizer and I love that the SPF has you covered for the day! This lotion combined with SPF does not irritate me sensitive skin which is an added bonus.
Making this SPF part of my daily routine it's amazing, the only scent it has is summer vibes! Feels so light on skin and I don't have to reapply it during the day!

Recently bought the sunscreen and moisturiser and I love it . it doesn't make my face oily or sweat after I put it looks so natural and effective doesn't leave any white look on the face after applying it.

I am one who like a simple skin care routine and this is the perfect product. My one "issue" is that I have to cut the packaging open when it is low as the pump can no longer reach the bottom.
I love this moisturizer. I love the fact it also has spf in it! I have never had any irritation with it and the finish has always been good for me. There's no odd scent either. I would recommend

This is a Cetaphil household through and through. I love their body wash so when I saw this on sale I had to try it. I love that it includes spf protection. I keep it right by my doorway so I can apply some as I walk out the door.

avis.titre: a gentle, lightweight, and non-greasy daily moistu
avis.texte: I've used Cetaphil's daily facial moisturizers and they're very reliable if I want something simple that hydrates without feeling heavy. They're lightweight, absorb quickly, and don't leave my skin greasy, which makes them easy to wear under makeup or on their own. The versions with SPF protect my skin from sun damage while still keeping it soft and comfortable all day. I've noticed that they're especially good for sensitive skin because they're gentle and fragrance‑free, but a few people say certain formulas can feel oily or irritating on very sensitive or acne‑prone skin, so results can vary.

I use Cetaphil SPF 35 sunscreen daily. It absorbs easily, and one important thing is that it doesn't leave a white cast and feels light on my skin. I really recommend it to you. It protects in sunny weather very well

As someone with pale, sensitive skin that burns easily, finding an SPF moisturizer that actually works without irritation is a challenge. Cetaphil's Daily SPF Moisturizer has been a reliable go-to, especially for the price. The texture is a little greasy at first but absorbs fairly well, leaving my skin feeling hydrated and protected. The scent isn't great — very neutral and a bit chemical — and the packaging is average, nothing fancy but functional. The only real downside is that it burns if it gets too close to the eyes, so I've learned to apply it carefully. During the summer, we spend most weekends out on the boat, and I can trust Cetaphil to keep my skin protected from the sun all day. For a budget-friendly SPF that works well with sensitive skin, it's definitely one I'll keep in my rotation.

As someone with combination sensitive skin, finding a daily face moisturizer that provides hydration and sun protection without causing breakouts or irritation can be a challenge. Cetaphil's Daily Oil-Free Facial Moisturizer with SPF 35 has become a dependable part of my skincare routine. The formula is impressively lightweight, gliding on smoothly and absorbing quickly without leaving any white cast or greasy residue. It provides just the right amount of moisture for both dry areas and oily zones, and it never feels heavy under makeup. Best of all, it's fragrance-free and non-comedogenic, which makes it ideal for sensitive or acne-prone skin.
This is one of my holy grail products; I love the dual purpose of a moisturizer and SPF. This doesn't feel greasy, goes into the skin nicely, and layers well under other products.

A good everyday cream since it includes SPF 35. I like the consistency; it's light but not shiny at all. It leaves your skin beautiful and smells good. As for the price, I think it's very reasonable considering the quality of the product. I love it. 🍀

I've been using this daily for a few months now since my dermatologist recommended it. I've never used a moisturizer before but I'm very happy with this one so far. The texture is nice I feel like my face doesn't look too oily. I really enjoy that it has spf so I don't need a separate sunscreen.
The texture is soothing. My daughter uses it everyday on her face. It gives the right amount of coverage needed and in expensive compared to other brands.

I've been using the Cetaphil Daily Moisturizer, and honestly, it's one of the most reliable drugstore staples in my routine. It's super lightweight, non-greasy, and layers beautifully under makeup. I love the Hydrating Lotion with Hyaluronic Acid—it keeps my skin feeling soft and plump all day without clogging pores. The SPF 15 version is great for daily wear too—moisturizer and sun protection in one step? Yes, please. It's fragrance-free, hypoallergenic, and perfect for sensitive or combo skin. Bonus: Miley Cyrus's MUA even used it for her Grammys look, which kinda sold me. The only downside? If you have acne-prone skin, test it first—some versions can trigger breakouts for a few people. Overall, it's affordable, gentle, and works really well.
One application caused a painful reaction. Face was red itchy and burning. Never had an allergic reaction to a "sensitive skin" product. Still days later still feel the Itching.

I've used this product before and I can say it works very well! I like it. I will say like many spf moisturizers it does leave your face a little dewy, but nothing overly greasy. If you have dry or combo skin it'll probably work great. I love that it spf and moisturizer, so its killing 2 birds with one stone.

The moisturizer is lightweight and works well when applying makeup. Great for dry/sensitive skin - especially with the added sun protection. My only complaint is the pump in the bottle. I've bought this product many times and the pump always breaks!

avis.titre: Great Product.  Bottle Design Should be Improved.
avis.texte: Great product. However, the bottle design is terrible! The sunscreen dispenser pump is a waste of plastic. I want Cetaphil to reconsider their bottle design. Is it possible to consider making the same product, yet place it in a different container? Can sunscreen be packaged in a container like "Rich Hydrating Cream"? Typically, sunscreen comes in containers that have to be squeezed out. Is there some mandate or law preventing sunscreen from being in this type of container? I have to use a child-safe paint brush just to get the remaining 30% of sunscreen out of the bottle. There has to be a more environmentally conscious design that provides better functionality than what is currently provided. Thank you for listening to my feedback.
Its have sun protection and the scents is not too stong. the packaging is good and ingredients is good for all skin type and the texture feel good.

**Cetaphil Daily Facial Moisturizer Review** Cetaphil's Daily Facial Moisturizer comes in simple, functional **packaging** with a clean design that makes it easy to apply. The **scent** is mild and non-irritating, making it suitable for sensitive skin. The **texture** is lightweight and smooth, absorbing quickly without leaving any greasy residue. It offers good **sun protection** with SPF 15, providing an added layer of defense against harmful UV rays. The **feel** is hydrating and gentle, leaving the skin soft and nourished. As for **ingredients**, it includes a blend of glycerin and emollients, which help maintain moisture balance without clogging pores, making it ideal for daily use. Overall, it's a reliable, gentle moisturizer for everyday skincare.

avis.titre: Lightweight, Oil-Free Moisturizer with Sun Protect
avis.texte: I've been using Cetaphil Daily Oil-Free Facial Moisturizer with SPF 35 for a while now, and I'm really impressed. This stuff is perfect. Hydrates without clogging pores; I wear it every day and haven't gotten sunburnt since. A little goes a long way. Worth the money.

avis.titre: Perfect as a daily at home moisturizer with spf 35, which...
avis.texte: I enjoy my moisturizer a lot, it's light, have sunscreen, melt into my skin leaving it with a hydrating feeling but I noticed that yesterday when I open it was white, and today it's kind of creamy, I imagine is one of the ingredients that make it change the color but as long as it didn't provoque me any reaction in my sensible skin, plus it's fragrance free, I understand maybe the formula is not as stable as others but it's good enough to keep it in mind in case someone needs an affordable and hydrating moisturizer. Also I'm using it in my hands and it works awesome!

First time trying this product, previously used Cetaphil Oil-Absorbing moisturizer. Consistency is good (creamy texture); no white cast. Giving it 4-stars because the pump is horrible and I've had to remove pump to get product out.
This works great. I use it in combination with a gentle face wash and my face has stayed moisturize I've had no issues with clogged pores or breakouts
This product is just so amazing. The packaging for this is amazing and makes it so easy to apply. Not to mention how effect it is for sunscreen. The texture and scent just are perfection!

I love the product for the convenience of having moisturizer and sunscreen in one bottle, but it comes at a cost that has me not using it as often as I otherwise would. First, it remains pretty visible on skin - no white cast, but it does leave me looking visibly greasy in a way that other moisturizers and even some sunscreen doesn't. This is a non-issue if I am wearing makeup over it, but having to put makeup on takes away from the convenience. The other issue is that it starts coming off my face after 12-16 hours of being on. Once it hits that point, it inevitably ends up stinging my eyes. As long as I put it on late in the morning and wash my face as soon as I get home from work, it is fine but if that is not an option I find myself reaching for something else.
I bought this product and found that my skin felt Hester after only one use.

I was looking for a new SPF and this had good enough reviews to give it a try. I absolutely love it. I have oily skin and this combined with a finishing powder leaves me oil free all day. It doesn't sting my eyes or cause my makeup to slip either.
If you have combination to oily skin, I would not recommend this product. It broke me out badly.

This moisturiser works very well with my normal to dry skin type, the cream hydrates and absorbs into my skin making my face feel fresh. This moisturiser fixed my skin barrier after over exfoliating. I apply this morning and night for smooth radiant skin 24/7
I have very weird skin lol. It's oily and dry. This is one of the face creams I can use and it help with the dryness but also not break me out like crazy.
I use this everyday, never makes me breakout, keeps my skin hydrated and from tanning. I recommend this to everyone I know. Has no scent and feels nice and light.

avis.titre: Easy to Apply but Extremely Greasy
avis.texte: Bought this in hopes that I would find a daily moisturizer and sunscreen combo that wouldn't leave an oil slick on my face. This worked as a sunscreen but has me super greasy 40 minutes after application and also caused some redness.
I like the scent not too strong. I apply the moisturizer it last long ,it is light but very good can't go wrong with it, I have recommended it to everyone I know. Good protection for the skin.

The packaging is very simple and easy to understand. The sun protection in it is great the absorption is really nice as well as the texture it's very moisturizing and my skin feels fresh. The moisturizer doesn't have a scent

This is a decent facial moisturizer with SPF. It definitely works as a sunscreen, and I like that it contains niacinamides. However, it does leave a slight white cast and stays greasy on the face. I don't like how it makes my face shiny under makeup. This is not for oily skin.
Although this moisturizer is marketed for sensitive skin it broke me out so bad and gave me a rash all over my face and chest. If you have sensitive skin beware!
I actually really like this! It worked well on my skin and I love the fact that it has spf in it. I'm a redhead so that's definitely needed. It makes my skin smooth and it moisturizes it well!

I bought this specifically for the SPF and the brand. It absorbs great into the skin and doesn't leave it oily. I began applying to my son so he can have sun protection at recess time. It doesn't have scent and perfect for daily life.
